While deeply familiar with jQuery's internals and debugging edge cases (such as distinguishing between plain objects and built-ins like `Math`), their profile lacks evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks or backend systems. Their work demonstrates strong problem-solving in object systems and performance tuning, but their contributions are limited to jQuery-specific contexts.
